notes: Cheats disable trophies and saving — keep cheats off for the whole run.
There is no mission replay in GTA 6, so do the Chapter 1 meditation (Positive Mental Attitude) before Chapter 1 ends.
The 100% checklist appears under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion after the story, but progress made during the story already counts.
One playthrough is enough. After the final mission you return to the open world and everything left can be cleaned up in free-roam.
The game is five chapters and takes around 60 to 80 hours of story. The full platinum is rated 4 out of 10 difficulty and about 200 hours.

stages.body: Play the story from the opening mission to the final mission, enjoy it, and pick up the easy activity trophies on the way. Do the first meditation in Chapter 1 — Lucia on the balcony at Jason's house — before the chapter ends, because it may be the only missable trophy. Try an arcade game, go bowling, and sample the activity types as you meet them; the story trophies pop on their own as the chapters and missions end.
tips: Meditate at Jason's house in Chapter 1 — do not skip it.
Finish the side-character strands (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) as they appear.
Scan vehicles and study animals with the binoculars as you travel — it counts toward 100% later.
stages.title: Step 1 — Finish the story

stages.body: After the final mission the 100% Completion checklist unlocks. Work through it: it is closer to 60% true completion, most side quests are not required, and you only need 70 of the 80 challenges. The jobs that need everything are the robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests. Gold all 42 shooting range challenges, win the drone races, finish the card sets and the vehicle and area counts, and the gold for 100% completion follows.
tips: Gold the 42 shooting range challenges — all of them are needed.
Win all 42 drone races: one win per location is the trophy, all 42 is the checklist.
You only need 70 of 80 challenges, so skip the ones you hate.
stages.title: Step 2 — 100% Completion checklist

stages.body: Mop up the stranger strands and the miscellaneous trophies in free-roam: eight qualifying stranger strands, the partner trophies, the combat and robbery one-offs, and the five trophies whose methods are not yet confirmed. When the last of these pops, the platinum is yours.
tips: Eight stranger strands count — Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are among them.
Do the partner trophies with your partner beside you.
Check the unconfirmed trophies last: their methods are still being worked out by players.
stages.title: Step 3 — Strangers, Freaks & cleanup
